parsed.note_claim: The 2024–2025 extended stay resulted from Boeing Starliner thruster failures and helium leaks, not toilet issues.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Boeing's Starliner spacecraft is docked to the ISS, where it has remained for months longer than planned due to unexpected thruster and helium leak issues.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly states the extended stay was caused by thruster and helium leak issues.
